name: ERA paper gender-bias probe v1
description: Fixed, cross-model single-token supports for the paper metrics. Every string includes its generation-boundary leading space.

excluded_concept_candidates.caregiver: Not a single token in the GPT-2/GPT-Neo, OPT and BLOOM tokenizers; excluded globally rather than changing K by model.

tokenisation_policy: Each declared string must encode to exactly one token ID in every measured model. Any failure aborts before inference; no word is silently skipped and no per-model support is substituted.
